material: cohesive Brazilian iron ore pellet/sinter feed fines
claim: literature-derived uncertainty envelope, not a statistical confidence interval and not site calibration

primary_sources.paper: Mohajeri et al., Bulk properties variability and interdependency determination for cohesive iron ore
primary_sources.used_data: three Brazilian cohesive iron ores; ring shear, wall friction and ledge tests over moisture and 2/8/20 kPa pre-consolidation

primary_sources.paper: Wang et al., Geotechnical properties of a type of iron ore fines
primary_sources.used_data: undrained Mohr-Coulomb friction angle 45.6 degrees; material specific gravity 4.444

Mohajeri_I1.particle_size: d50 approximately 0.053 mm; all three Mohajeri samples tested over 0.053-1.4 mm sieve range

Mohajeri_I3.particle_size: finer than the 0.053 mm lower sieve used; d50 not resolved

Wang_IOF.material_type: iron ore fines cargo for liquefaction study
Wang_IOF.particle_size: all particles pass 9.5 mm; 33.5% gravel, 42.9% sand, 17.1% silt, 6.5% clay
Wang_IOF.triaxial_condition: saturated, 50-200 kPa initial effective confinement, 92.8-95.0% compaction degree

rho_bulk_kg_m3.condition: loose Minas-Rio pellet feed through Carajas sinter feed sheared at 20 kPa; as-received moisture

endpoint_provenance.low: Mohajeri I3, as-received 6.8% dry-basis moisture, initial loose ring-shear fill
endpoint_provenance.reference: Mohajeri I2, as-received 8.7% dry-basis moisture, initial loose ring-shear fill
endpoint_provenance.high: Mohajeri I2, as-received 8.7% dry-basis moisture, after shearing at 20 kPa consolidation

internal_friction_angle_deg.condition: moisture and stress-history dependent; high endpoint is an undrained triaxial result on a different iron ore fines cargo
internal_friction_angle_deg.method: linear ring-shear yield locus / Mohr-Coulomb triaxial envelope

endpoint_provenance.low: Mohajeri I3 mean linear yield locus at 2 kPa pre-consolidation over moisture sweep
endpoint_provenance.reference: Mohajeri I3 mean linear yield locus at 20 kPa pre-consolidation over moisture sweep
endpoint_provenance.high: Wang IOF, saturated undrained monotonic triaxial peak envelope at 50-200 kPa effective confinement

cohesion_pa.condition: low endpoint includes reported 0.8 +/- 0.1 kPa at 2 kPa pre-consolidation; high endpoint bounds the reported 1.3 kPa moisture-driven span in the more cohesive sample
cohesion_pa.endpoint_note: high is derived from the reported 1.3 kPa span corresponding to 77%, not a directly tabulated universal constant

endpoint_provenance.low: Mohajeri I3 lower bound of 0.8 +/- 0.1 kPa at 2 kPa pre-consolidation
endpoint_provenance.reference: Mohajeri I3 mean at 2 kPa pre-consolidation
endpoint_provenance.high: engineering upper endpoint inferred from Mohajeri I2's reported 1.3 kPa/77% moisture-driven span

tool_wall_friction_angle_deg.condition: normal stress 1.1-17.1 kPa and moisture sweep; tested wall coupon in ring shear cell
tool_wall_friction_angle_deg.method: wall friction test against blasted hot-rolled stainless steel plate

endpoint_provenance.low: Mohajeri I2, 17.1 kPa wall normal stress across moisture sweep
endpoint_provenance.reference: Mohajeri I1, high wall normal stress endpoint
endpoint_provenance.high: Mohajeri I3 average at 1.1 kPa wall normal stress, excluding stated dry outlier

angle_of_repose_deg.condition: ledge test over three iron ore types and moisture range; excludes non-flowing near-liquid outlier
